nodes.description: Ownable.owner: address of contract owner, written in constructor and transferOwnership, read in onlyOwner check.
Allow.allowedMap: mapping(address=>bool) authorization whitelist modified by allowAccess/denyAccess and read by allow modifier.
Allow.allowedArray: dynamic array of allowed addresses appended in allowAccess.
Copyright.list: dynamic bytes32 array of stored hashes, pushed in save and read in count.
Ownable constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment.
transferOwnership(address): onlyOwner-guarded ownership transfer that writes owner.
Allow.allowAccess(address): onlyOwner-guarded function that whitelists an address and appends it to allowedArray.
Allow.denyAccess(address): onlyOwner-guarded function that removes an address from the whitelist.
Allow constructor: empty, inherits Ownable constructor chain.
Copyright.save(bytes32): allow-guarded function that pushes a hash into list.
Copyright.count(): view function returning list.length.
Copyright constructor: empty, inherits Allow/Ownable constructor chain.
onlyOwner modifier: require(msg.sender == owner) access-control gate applied to owner functions.
allow modifier: require(allowedMap[msg.sender] == true) access-control gate applied to save.
msg.sender used to initialize owner in Ownable constructor.
msg.sender compared to owner inside onlyOwner modifier (authorization decision).
msg.sender used as key into allowedMap inside the allow modifier.
msg.sender emitted as _handler in AddressAllowed event inside allowAccess.
msg.sender emitted as _handler in AddressDenied event inside denyAccess.
owner = newOwner state write in transferOwnership (privilege transfer).
allowedMap[_address] = true privileged whitelist write in allowAccess.
allowedMap[_address] = false privileged whitelist write in denyAccess.
list.push(_hash) append operation in save.
allowedArray.push(_address) append operation in allowAccess.
owner = msg.sender privileged state write in Ownable constructor.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership: destination address for ownership transfer.
Parameter _address of allowAccess: address to whitelist and append.
Parameter _address of denyAccess: address to remove from whitelist.
Parameter _hash of save: bytes32 hash stored in list.
Local bool exists in allowAccess tracking duplicate membership in allowedArray.
Local loop counter i in allowAccess iterating over allowedArray.

edges.reason: onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of allowAccess.
onlyOwner modifier gates execution of denyAccess.
allow modifier gates execution of save based on allowedMap.
msg.sender flows into the owner equality check that authorizes onlyOwner functions.
msg.sender indexes allowedMap in the allow modifier authorization check.
msg.sender is passed as the handler argument of the AddressAllowed event emitted by allowAccess.
msg.sender is passed as the handler argument of the AddressDenied event emitted by denyAccess.
Parameter newOwner is consumed by transferOwnership to change the privileged owner.
newOwner is written into the owner state slot by the privileged transfer operation.
Ownership transfer operation mutates the owner state variable.
Parameter _address is consumed by allowAccess.
_address is used as the key for the privileged allowedMap write in allowAccess.
allowedMap whitelist write mutates the allowedMap state mapping.
Parameter _address is consumed by denyAccess.
_address is used as the key for the privileged allowedMap write in denyAccess.
Whitelist removal mutates the allowedMap state mapping.
Parameter _hash is pushed into list by the save operation.
list.push mutates the list state array.
_address is appended to allowedArray by the push operation in allowAccess.
allowedArray.push mutates the allowedArray state array.
allowAccess executes the allowedMap=true privileged write.
denyAccess executes the allowedMap=false privileged write.
transferOwnership executes the owner assignment operation.
Ownable constructor executes the owner initialization write.
msg.sender is stored as the initial owner by the constructor write.
Constructor owner initialization mutates the owner state variable.
Allow inherits Ownable, so the Ownable constructor runs in the Allow construction chain.
Copyright inherits Allow, so the Allow constructor runs in the Copyright construction chain.
count reads list.length from the list state array.
Local exists tracks duplicate detection inside allowAccess.
Local loop counter i drives the allowedArray scan inside allowAccess.
save executes the list.push append operation.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter newOwner exists only to feed the owner write inside transferOwnership; merge into that function node.
Parameter _address is only consumed by allowAccess for the whitelist and array writes; merge into that function node.
Parameter _address is only consumed by denyAccess for the whitelist removal; merge into that function node.
Parameter _hash is only consumed by save when appending to list; merge into that function node.
Local exists is a temporary duplicate-detection flag scoped to allowAccess; merge into that function node.
Local i is a loop counter scoped to allowAccess; merge into that function node.
